# CC16: 鉴园 Jian Yuan

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC16` · Page: `/scenes/#CC16` · Row: `research/buildings/CC16-jian-yuan/`

## What it was

鉴园 Jian Yuan, "Mirror Garden", lay east of 映清斋 on the long lake north-east of 如园 (S05 j83:18a; E0307, E0324). 日下旧闻考: an open five-bay range facing west, 漱琼斋 to the north, 师善堂 east of it, and a boathouse behind (S05 j83:18a: 鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂 ... 鑑園之後有船塢). Of 1767, after 趣园 at Yangzhou; S361 adds 开益轩 north, 芳晖楼 and 绿净榭 south (E0324). Repaired in 1810 (E0165). Seven short visits in poems, 1773-1811, all on the water view (E0323). Not among the buildings left standing after 1860 (E0451, after 刘敦桢), so it burned in October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 乾隆三十二年 1767 (S48, lead); **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S48, S01, S361).

## What survives today

In 2015 the 鉴园 site, in the south-east of Changchun Yuan against the east wall, had had no archaeological work and no protection; its remains lay in the open, mostly standing in water, scattered and overgrown (S592, Xiaoqi 2015, CC BY 3.0, section 3.1).
